g.textArea: One pan on the K4 day: every product on it adds its pieces, and the total becomes whole pans.

K4 (Mix-Slice-Oven!K4): Demand is for this day. This week Tuesday.
Products: Pans/Boxes (which pan a product goes on) and Pieces Per Tray/Case.
Pans: Pieces Per Pan for each pan or box.
_Production on DSD_DSnD (packs) or Dist_DSnD (F5 cases) for the K4 day.

Row list (A410) =LET(pn,FILTER(Pans[Pans/Boxes],Pans[Pans/Boxes]<>""),sku,Products[No.],pan,Products[Pans/Boxes],gpg,Products[Gen. Prod. Posting Group],DROP(REDUCE("",pn,LAMBDA(a,p,LET(m,FILTER(sku,(pan=p)*(gpg<>"OBS"),""),IF(AND(ROWS(m)=1,INDEX(m,1)=""),a,VSTACK(a,p,m))))),1))
# of Pans/Boxes to set out (P) =IFERROR(IF([@Pans]<>"Pan","",ROUNDUP(SUMPRODUCT(--(XLOOKUP(Oven_Info[Finished Product],Products[No.],Products[Pans/Boxes],"")=[@Finished Product]),IFERROR(--Oven_Info[Demand],0),IFERROR(--Oven_Info['# of pieces per tray/box],0))/[@Pieces Per Pan],0)),"")
MCS Schedule F29 =LET(p,Oven_Info[Pans],nm,Oven_Info[Finished Product],n,IFERROR(--Oven_Info['# of Pans/Boxes to set out],0),nx,DROP(VSTACK(p,""),1),FILTER(HSTACK(nm,n),(p="Pan")*(nx="MCS LINE")*(n>0),"No MCS pans"))

3.5" Challah Onion Bun pan, Tuesday: F3082 (MCS LINE) is short 55 packs x 12 pieces = 660 pieces.
Pans: 660 / 28 pieces per pan = 23.6, ROUNDUP = 24. MCS Schedule F29 lists it: 24.
(Grande) Large Croissant: F8006 76 x 1 = 76 pieces / 10 = 7.6, so 8 pans. It is 3rd Party - Bake, so F29 skips it.

Should the Breadline Schedule and 3rd Party - Bake products get their own pan list?
Should F29 check every product on a pan instead of only the first one under it?
Should the print area be widened to include rows 453 to 477?

flowchart TD classDef terminator fill:#FFFFFF,stroke:#757575,color:#313131 classDef input fill:#B3E65F,stroke:#6E9A24,color:#2F440B classDef export fill:#B8ACFB,stroke:#8A7BE0,color:#231266 classDef calc fill:#9CE6FF,stroke:#2C97BB,color:#1C4657 classDef decision fill:#9CE6FF,stroke:#2C97BB,color:#1C4657 classDef lookup fill:#FFB575,stroke:#CC7830,color:#542700 classDef output fill:#DDDDD8,stroke:#8A8A7E,color:#434339 classDef issue fill:#FFC6C6,stroke:#BD0A0A,color:#5C0A0A s(["One pan on the K4 day"]):::terminator rows[/"A410 row list: the pan,
then each non-OBS product on it"/]:::lookup k4[/"K4 day selector: Tuesday"/]:::input d[/"Demand = packs short on the K4 day
from DSD_DSnD or Dist_DSnD"/]:::lookup pc["pieces = Demand x
pieces per tray/box"]:::calc sum["Pan row: SUMPRODUCT over products
whose Pans/Boxes is this pan"]:::calc pp[/"Pieces Per Pan from Pans"/]:::lookup set["Set out = ROUNDUP(pieces / Pieces Per Pan)"]:::calc q{{"Product under the pan on MCS LINE
and set out above 0?"}}:::decision f29(["Listed on MCS Schedule F29"]):::terminator no["Counted but not printed:
no pan list for other lines"]:::issue s --> rows rows --> d k4 --> d d --> pc pc --> sum sum --> set pp --> set set --> q q -->|"Yes"| f29 q -->|"No"| no
